meta_description: Clear answers to questions about children, the mind and calm, written by specialists and clinically reviewed before publication.
hero_lead: Real questions about children, the mind and calm, with answers a specialist signs with their own name.
ask_placeholder: Ask the guide about a topic…
ask_suggest_2: When do the first articles come out?
ask_suggest_3: What does the guide do, and not do?
guide_intro: Hi, I'm the blog's guide. I answer from published, reviewed articles and show you where each answer comes from.
guide_footer: The guide is not a substitute for a consultation.
guide_refusal_crisis: If you or someone near you is in danger, call 112 now.
guide_refusal_out_of_scope: The guide does not diagnose, does not recommend treatment and does not talk about medication. For that, the right person is a specialist.
guide_refusal_no_content: I don't have a checked answer to that yet — the first articles are with their clinical reviewers. Meanwhile, I'm happy to show you how we write and check them.
guide_refusal_unavailable: I can't answer just now. Try again in a little while; meanwhile, here is how we write and check our articles.
coming_text: What we are writing now. We publish each article only after a clinician has reviewed and signed it.
byline_pending: Author and reviewer: to be confirmed
in_review_row: Being written and reviewed by a psychologist before publication.
in_review_standfirst: Article in progress: it is being written and reviewed by a psychologist before publication.
in_review_note: Until the clinical review, we publish not a single line of it. Meanwhile you can ask the guide or go straight to the team.
in_review_policy: How we write and review our articles
empty_text: The first articles are being prepared and will appear here after review.
article_guide_title: Ask the guide about this article
article_guide_intro: Ask me whatever isn’t clear. I answer only from reviewed content and show you the source.
footer_tagline: Written by people, reviewed by clinicians, read in peace.
notfound_text: It may have moved, or it may not be written yet. Every article is on the front page.
rss_description: Articles written by specialists and clinically reviewed before publication.
compass_placeholder: What are you looking for, or want to know?
guide_refusal_injection: Here I can only help with questions about our articles. What are you curious about?
guide_refusal_abuse: Let's keep it respectful. I'm glad to help with any question about the articles.
guide_refusal_rate_limited: A short pause: lots of questions in a short time. Try again in a minute.
guide_refusal_exchange_limit: Let's pause here for today. Come back tomorrow — the articles will be here.
draft_note: Draft for review: this text does not appear on the public site until a person on the team has read and approved it.
draft_note_health: Draft for clinical review: this text does not appear on the public site until a clinician on the team approves it, by name.
draft_ai: Written with the help of AI, from our internal material.
draft_provenance: Where the facts come from (for review)
account_nav_hint: Your reading list and your Psi account.
account_lead: One account for the blog, Psizone, EQ-SYNC and Hemi-Sync. Sign in once and every site knows you.
account_signed_out_lead: Sign in with your Psi account to keep a reading list. Our sites never ask for or keep a password.
account_unavailable: Sign-in is not available right now.
account_privacy_note: We keep only what you chose: no clinical record, no diagnosis. You can ask for an export or for your account to be erased at any time.
account_saved_empty: You have not saved an article yet. Open one and choose “Save this article” in the compass.
account_saved_unavailable: The list cannot be checked right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
account_save_nav_hint: Keep it in your reading list.
account_save_lead: “{title}” goes into your reading list. Only you can see it.
account_unavailable_lead: We cannot check access right now. Nothing is lost; please try again in a few minutes.
preview_incomplete_text: The blog shows an article only when it is complete, in both languages. Still missing: {fields}.
account_timeline_empty: Nothing here yet. When you book, save an article or give a consent, it shows up here.
account_profile_lead: Only what we need to reach you. We fill them into forms for you, and you can change them any time.
account_profile_name: The name you'd like us to use
account_profile_email_note: This comes from your Psi account; change it there.
account_profile_contact: How you'd like us to reach you
account_profile_language: The language we write to you in
account_profile_invalid: Something doesn't fit: check the phone number (we need it if you'd like a call).
account_consents_lead: Each consent stands on its own and you can withdraw it any time. When you do, we delete what we kept for it, straight away.
account_purpose_guide_memory_title: Remember my conversations with the guide
account_purpose_guide_memory_text: The guide remembers what you talked about, so you don't start over. You can read and delete them under Conversations. It is not a clinical record.
account_purpose_booking_contact_text: We may contact you about your booking requests the way you prefer.
account_purpose_programme_progress_text: The days you've done and your protocols, so you carry on where you left off.
account_bookings_lead: The requests you made while signed in. You can cancel the upcoming ones.
account_bookings_empty: You have no booking requests in your account yet.
account_bookings_off: Appointments are booked on Psizone; you'll find them in your account there.
account_bookings_link_lead: We add it here if you have the reference and the cancel code you were given. Without both, nothing is tied to your account.
account_bookings_link_failed: We couldn't find a request with that reference and code.
account_bookings_linked: The request is now in your account.
account_conversations_lead: Only with your consent. What you delete here is gone for good.
account_conversations_off: Right now we keep nothing you ask. If you'd like the guide to remember, give your consent.
account_conversations_empty: No conversation kept yet. Ask the guide something and you'll find it here.
account_data_lead: Everything we keep about you, in plain view.
account_export_text: A JSON file with your profile, consents, appointments, saved articles and kept conversations.
account_erase_text: We erase your profile, consents, conversations and reading list on every Psi site, and sign you out everywhere. Booking requests stay with the clinic, no longer tied to you.
account_erase_mismatch: The word didn't match, so nothing was erased.
account_data_elsewhere: Everything in your account, appointments included, is kept together on Psizone. Download it or erase your account there, for every site at once.
account_data_elsewhere_button: Go to your data on Psizone
account_soon_text: We're preparing one account for Psizone, EQ-SYNC, Hemi-Sync and the blog. Until then, everything here works without one: you can read, ask the guide and request an appointment.
account_security_text: When you sign out, we sign you out of every Psi site at once: Psizone, EQ-SYNC, Hemi-Sync and the blog.
account_card_next_empty: No appointment coming up. Whenever you're ready, we'll find a time together.
account_card_book_elsewhere: Evaluations are booked on Psizone, with this same account.
account_card_saved_empty: Nothing saved yet. On the blog, choose “Save this article” in the compass.
account_card_memory_on: The guide remembers what you talked about. You can read and delete them any time.
account_card_memory_off: The guide keeps nothing you ask.
guide_dropped: The answer didn't arrive: the connection dropped.
guide_unanswered: No answer: you sent a new question.
shelf_despre: About us and how we work
